helpful: Provisioned petition.txt with clean text extraction: the questions presented alone settled the forecast.
The sal-v4 band table with bracketed reached rates, pooled over prior Terms, gave a direct anchor.
context.json's frozen band and distribution_count removed any need to derive conditioning state.
gaps: fedcourts query has no case-content similarity axis (petitioner type, subject, lower-court basis), so it cannot surface comparable priors for a pro se petition.
No committed cut for relist hazard conditional on a waived response or on pro se status; the relist-increment claim is banked on judgment.
No cut for the Long Conference specifically, where reschedules are more common than at an ordinary conference.
notes: Forward mode with unrestricted retrieval, but no CourtListener MCP call was needed: the provisioned record and petition text were sufficient. A single structured corpus query was run and did not inform the number.
